scope: Spell lifecycles: cast, held condition, walk with it on, rule-based end and a walk afterwards; real server recordings only.

cases.label: Command
cases.qualification: Original server follower packets; legal SDK commands for the cast, the walk with the condition on, its rule-based end and a walk afterwards. Fact coverage only, not native rendering or artistic approval.
cases.ending: Rule: Grovel spends the target's next turn prone and ends when that commanded turn ends; Prone ends when it stands at its following turn.
lifecycle_gaps: Command (Grovel, the only word the SDK offers) denies the commanded turn, so the target cannot walk with it on.
